definitions.explanation: The act or means of keeping something under control — an emotion, a rise in prices, or one's authority over others.

definitions.gloss: closer; relief pitcher who finishes the game (baseball)
definitions.explanation: The relief pitcher brought in to protect a lead and record the final outs, typically in the last inning.

examples.english: I can't keep my emotions in check.

notes:
The noun form of {抑|おさ}える (to hold down, to restrain). The baseball 'closer' sense pictures the pitcher who holds the opponent down at the end of the game.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抑|おさ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to have control or authority (over people)
- {抑|おさ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きかない: to be unable to keep something in check
- {抑|おさ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧: closing pitcher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦クローザー→クローザー：30005_kuroozaa⟧: closer — the loanword for the same baseball role
